annotation.title_clean: 商务部等9单位关于印发《2026“乐购新春”春节特别活动方案》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice by the Ministry of Commerce and 8 Other Bodies on Issuing the 2026 "Le Gou Xin Chun" Spring Festival Special Activity Plan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 商务部 (Ministry of Commerce of China) and other departments
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Ministry of Commerce and partner bodies issue a plan for Spring Festival consumption promotion (15–23 Feb 2026), covering food, lodging, travel, shopping and entertainment campaigns, trade-in subsidies, financial support and inbound tourism. It has no AI or robotics governance content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Campaign runs 15–23 February 2026 with unified activity logo
Six themed activity areas: food, lodging, travel, tourism, shopping, entertainment
Support measures: prize invoices, expanded trade-in subsidies, financial incentives, cross-sector ticket perks
Measures to ease inbound tourist consumption and payments
Local authorities to monitor holiday market and ensure safety
